claude.request:
Today's international headlines:
- US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China: The new levies would hit many of America's biggest trading partners, including China and the EU.
- Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater: The asteroid's surface was transformed after a spacecraft was deliberately crashed into it four years ago
- Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway: Another 21 are injured after the tanker reportedly overturns on a busy ring road in the Egyptian capital.
- Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?: Jihadist groups appear to be focusing on local issues rather than global terror. Does it signify a real change?
- Israeli judges recommend dropping most serious charges against Netanyahu: The Israeli PM says his trial should end after judges said there was little chance of conviction in one of three cases.
- US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify: All three main US indexes were down in early trading, with the tech-dominated Nasdaq down almost 4%.
- US Army says controlled blast of explosives in Iowa was 'huge success': Despite widespread concern from residents ahead of the blast, officials say that lead readings in the area so far have been promising.
- California warns of flooding as King Tides peak over Thanksgiving: Parts of the Canadian province of British Columbia may also be affected by the storms and flooding, which come as millions of people travel for the holiday.
- FedEx plane overshoots Miami runway, with flights briefly suspended at airport: The brief ground stop comes on the day before the US Thanksgiving holiday, one of the busiest travel days of the year.
- Trump's accounts traded Nvidia shares 44 times this year, records show: A review of the US president's financial disclosures shows Donald Trump's investment portfolios have regularly traded shares in the tech giant.
- Macy's postpones Thanksgiving parade due to severe weather: The was the first time ever that the iconic celebration was delayed because of storms. New York expects damaging winds and heavy rainfall over the Thanksgiving holiday.
- Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt settle legal battle over French winery: The Hollywood A-listers' legal battle focused on the vineyard they bought in 2008 and where they wed six years later.

image_provider.prompt: A massive interconnected web of dominoes and gears, partially collapsed and on fire, suspended over a churning ocean during a storm. The structure is half-destroyed, with some pieces still falling, others frozen mid-tumble. Lightning illuminates the chaos. Style: bold geometric forms, high contrast, dramatic diagonal composition, industrial and dystopian. Colors should read as deep blues, oranges, and blacks even in duotone.
